newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean business groups' capital/asset ratio down.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean business groups' capital/asset ratio down.

text.p: The capital-to-asset ratio of South Korea's 49 business groups fell to an average of 20.1 percent at the end of 1996 from 22.2 percent a year earlier, the central Bank of Korea said on Tuesday.
The bank also said in a statement combined assets of the 49 business groups, each with bank loans of 250 billion won or more, rose 22.7 percent to 371 trillion won in 1996.
Net profits of the 49 groups dropped 99.1 percent to a combined 57.7 billion won in 1996 from 6.1 trillion won in 1995, the statement said.
"Overall economic slowdown was mainly to blame for the profit fall," said a central bank official.
